notes: Assumptions that move the number: 1 cup raw brown rice ≈ 195 g (716 kcal); a large avocado ≈ 200 g flesh (320 kcal) counted because it is an ingredient line; drained black beans at the boiled-bean value (132 kcal) — a canned drained figure nearer 115 kcal would save ~20 kcal a serving. Juice of both limes counted. Cross-check: published sweet potato and black bean chillies list ~400–450 kcal without rice; adding ~49 g raw brown rice (~180) and a quarter avocado (~80) gives ~660–710, so 690 agrees. It is above the ~650 healthy ceiling because rice and avocado are both in the recipe. Published figures are recalled, not re-fetched (the shared web budget was spent). Trimmed 2026-10-29 to ¾ cup rice and one medium avocado so a serving sits under the healthy tag’s ~650 kcal (was 690).
